content:
#4 In the git repository of the nLab, running the command

git --no-pager log --name-only -1 --all --grep='Page name: philosophy - contents'

tells you that the page with such a title is located in the file

pages/7/2/3/8/8327/content.md

and the corresponding file

pages/7/2/3/8/8327/name

contains its current title.
